tool_arguments.prompt:
Create NEW hand-painted pose drawings from scratch, using the attached adopted neutral solely as exact character identity and drawing-style reference. This is a production sprite image, not a character redesign. Genuine transparent RGBA background. Make a TALL PORTRAIT canvas (1024x1536 or larger native portrait) with EXACTLY THREE separate complete drawings in ONE VERTICAL COLUMN, top/middle/bottom in the order below; each drawing large, centered in its own equally sized band, with generous transparent gutter and padding. No panel boxes, letters, labels, floor, shadow, colored backdrop, effect/speed lines, sparkles, water or props. Preserve the reference warm brown contour, same thin-to-medium edge, simple dot eyes, soft watercolor/paper texture contained entirely within painted silhouette, color blocks, head/body proportions and simplification. Do not become realistic, do not add costume or human limbs. Compact gray dugong, broad cream muzzle with short whisker marks, cream underside, exactly two flippers and a broad forked whale-like tail. The three poses must have the same anatomical size and stationary support/body center; do not fit them independently or enlarge quieter poses. Show every appendage without clipping or overlap with other rows.
1. present_right: Clearly present toward VIEWER RIGHT with an attached existing wing/fin; turn the face to viewer right, draw this reverse view afresh, not a digital mirror.
2. think: A small thoughtful head dip, gaze downward, maintaining compact torso and support.
3. aha: A small alert discovery expression, look slightly upward and lift the existing near wing/fin/pincer, body grounded or floating as before.
RETRY REQUIREMENT: Prior source is rejected because a broad pale semitransparent cloud exists OUTSIDE the animals, including the top edge. Paint absolutely no atmosphere, wash, halo, light or shadow outside the character contours. Every outside pixel must be transparent alpha0. Preserve these same three full poses with generous outer padding.

original_output.availability: Historical tool location; bundled saved_output is the usable original.
